lead_deck: Finike-Kalkan divided highway project receives 'Environmental Impact Assessment Positive' decision
lead_body: A 'Environmental Impact Assessment Positive' decision has been made for the Finike-Kalkan divided highway project. The project will make it easier to get around the region. Residents of Kalkan and Kaş, and tourists, are curious about the contributions of the new road project to the region.
